with office salaries, so no query separates an office salary from a driver's pay.

reconcile exactly, which is what fixes the period: 55 hours is a week, not a month.
The shop block is EXCLUDED from trucking break-even at the operator's instruction
('we will calculate shop independently'). It is recorded here so the exclusion is
explicit and reversible, not silently dropped.
